name: @hucj/dsh-move-session
description: Cross-workspace session migration for the dsh web GUI (DSH 0.2.x): a Move Session header action plus a session-row menu entry and dialog (target workspace picker, keep-or-archive the original), idle-session only, full context preserved. Hot-pluggable — mounted as a profile bundle, no dsh source changes.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && npm test
scripts.test:ui: python scripts/test_dialog_fixed.py && python scripts/test_menu_injection.py && python scripts/test_theme.py

author: hucj
